title: VerificationResult has no helper to check overall success
description: In smime-tree/src/verify.rs, the VerificationResult doc comment says 'The caller should check whether at least one signer has verified == true.' But there is no is_verified() or any_verified() method on VerificationResult to express this. Every caller must write the same iteration. This is a usability gap for the 2am user — the type's own documentation describes a check the type cannot perform by itself. Add a method or document the pattern more concretely (e.g. show the idiomatic check in the doc comment).
